theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.whitehead_vc_innerSum_half :
Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => 2 * Real.pi / ↑N * Real.log (WhiteheadVC.whiteheadInnerSum N (N / 2))) Filter.atTop (nhds (4 * WhiteheadVC.catalanG))

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.whiteheadS_explicit_saddle_tendsto :
Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => 2 * Real.pi / ↑N * Real.log (WhiteheadVC.whiteheadS N (N / 2) (N / 4))) Filter.atTop (nhds (4 * WhiteheadVC.catalanG))

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.two_pi_log_whiteheadS_le_all {N k : ℕ} (hN : 4 ≤ N) (hkn : k + N / 2 ≤ N - 1) :
2 * Real.pi / ↑N * Real.log (WhiteheadVC.whiteheadS N (N / 2) k) ≤ whiteheadUmax N

noncomputable def QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.whiteheadUmax (N : ℕ) :
ℝ

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.devErr_nonneg (N : ℕ) :
0 ≤ devErr N

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.two_pi_log_whiteheadS_le {N k : ℕ} (hN : 4 ≤ N) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k + N / 2 ≤ N - 1) :
2 * Real.pi / ↑N * Real.log (WhiteheadVC.whiteheadS N (N / 2) k) ≤ 4 * clausen (Real.pi - ↑(N / 2) * (Real.pi / ↑N)) + clausen (2 * (↑(N / 2) * (Real.pi / ↑N))) + 10 * devErr N

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.clausen_nonneg {θ : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ θ) (h2 : θ ≤ Real.pi) :
0 ≤ clausen θ

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.gridPrim_ge {N K : ℕ} (hN : 4 ≤ N) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hKN : K ≤ N - 1) :
-clausen (2 * (↑K * (Real.pi / ↑N))) / 2 - devErr N ≤ gridPrim N K

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.gridPrim_le {N K : ℕ} (hN : 4 ≤ N) (hK : 1 ≤ K) (hKN : K ≤ N - 1) :
gridPrim N K ≤ -clausen (2 * (↑K * (Real.pi / ↑N))) / 2 + devErr N

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.tendsto_devErr :
Filter.Tendsto devErr Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

noncomputable def QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.devErr (N : ℕ) :
ℝ

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.clausen_diff_le_shift {θ s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hsπ : s ≤ Real.pi) (h0 : 0 ≤ θ) (h2 : θ ≤ 2 * Real.pi - s) :
clausen θ - clausen (θ + s) ≤ 2 * clausen (Real.pi - s / 2)

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.hasDerivAt_clausen_diff_shift {θ s : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < θ) (h2 : θ + s < 2 * Real.pi) (hs : 0 < s) :
HasDerivAt (fun (t : ℝ) => clausen t - clausen (t + s)) (Real.log (2 * Real.sin ((θ + s) / 2)) - Real.log (2 * Real.sin (θ / 2))) θ

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.clausen_diff_le {θ : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ θ) (h2 : θ ≤ Real.pi) :
clausen θ - clausen (θ + Real.pi) ≤ 2 * clausen (Real.pi / 2)

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.hasDerivAt_clausen_diff {θ : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < θ) (h2 : θ < Real.pi) :
HasDerivAt (fun (t : ℝ) => clausen t - clausen (t + Real.pi)) (Real.log (2 * Real.sin ((θ + Real.pi) / 2)) - Real.log (2 * Real.sin (θ / 2))) θ

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.gridpt_tendsto {a b c : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (Kseq : ℕ → ℕ) (hlo : ∀ (N : ℕ), a * N ≤ b * Kseq N + c) (hhi : ∀ (N : ℕ), b * Kseq N ≤ a * N) :
Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => 2 * (↑(Kseq N) * (Real.pi / ↑N))) Filter.atTop (nhds (2 * (↑a / ↑b) * Real.pi))

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.gridPrim_tendsto (Kseq : ℕ → ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (hK1 : ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, 1 ≤ Kseq N) (hKN : ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, Kseq N ≤ N - 1) (hgrid : Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => 2 * (↑(Kseq N) * (Real.pi / ↑N))) Filter.atTop (nhds θ)) :
Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => gridPrim N (Kseq N)) Filter.atTop (nhds (-clausen θ / 2))

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.two_pi_log_whiteheadS_eq {N n k : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hkn : k + n ≤ N - 1) :
2 * Real.pi / ↑N * Real.log (WhiteheadVC.whiteheadS N n k) = 4 * gridPrim N (k + n) - 4 * gridPrim N k - 2 * gridPrim N n

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.whiteheadS_sin_pos {N n k j : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hj1 : 1 ≤ j) (hjn : j ≤ n) (hkn : k + n ≤ N - 1) :
0 < Real.sin ((↑k + ↑j) * (Real.pi / ↑N)) ∧ 0 < Real.sin (↑j * (Real.pi / ↑N))

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.gridPrim_shift {N n k : ℕ} :
Real.pi / ↑N * ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, Real.log (2 * Real.sin ((↑k + ↑j) * (Real.pi / ↑N))) = gridPrim N (k + n) - gridPrim N k

noncomputable def QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.gridPrim (N K : ℕ) :
ℝ

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.catalanG_eq_clausen_pi_div_two :
WhiteheadVC.catalanG = clausen (Real.pi / 2)

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.sin_odd_index_vanish (k : ℕ) :
Real.sin ((2 * ↑k + 1 + 1) * (Real.pi / 2)) = 0

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.sin_two_mul_add_one_mul_pi_div_two (k : ℕ) :
Real.sin ((2 * ↑k + 1) * (Real.pi / 2)) = (-1) ^ k

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.saddle_integral :
∫ (u : ℝ) in 0..1 / 2, 2 * Real.log (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi * (u + 1 / 4))) - Real.log (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi * u)) = 2 * clausen (Real.pi / 2) / Real.pi

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.integral_A :
∫ (u : ℝ) in 0..1 / 2, Real.log (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi * (u + 1 / 4))) = clausen (Real.pi / 2) / Real.pi

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.integral_B_zero :
∫ (u : ℝ) in 0..1 / 2, Real.log (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi * u)) = 0

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.clausen_three_pi_div_two :
clausen (3 * Real.pi / 2) = -clausen (Real.pi / 2)

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.intervalIntegrable_log_two_sin_pi (a b : ℝ) :
IntervalIntegrable (fun (u : ℝ) => Real.log (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi * u))) MeasureTheory.volume a b

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.log_factor_reduce {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < Real.sin a) (hb : 0 < Real.sin b) :
Real.log (2 * Real.sin a ^ 2 / Real.sin b) = 2 * Real.log (2 * Real.sin a) - Real.log (2 * Real.sin b)

theorem QOU.Knot.WhiteheadSaddle.integral_log_two_sin_pi (b : ℝ) :
∫ (u : ℝ) in 0..b, Real.log (2 * Real.sin (Real.pi * u)) = -clausen (2 * (Real.pi * b)) / (2 * Real.pi)
